Thunderdome has been going strong for eight consecutive seasons, and one of the factors behind its popularity has been the way that players are matched against opponents of similar skill in a judgement made primarily by head admin  {{player|VVD|flag=ru}}. 
Main change in this season is replacement of [[dm6]] by [[bravado]].
